text:
maria.g: Draft release notes for the staging roll — copying bullets here, need quick eyes and a 1-line internal blurb for #internal-announce.

maria.g: Release highlights:
```
- Pin runtime to v2.14.1
- Model pin: embed-1b-q4 for embeddings route
- Canary: 10% on dedicated-us-east-1 for 30m
- Rollback policy: auto -> v2.14.0 on >=5% error rate sustained for 2m; manual rollback owner: kevin_h
- Change window: 01:00-03:00 UTC
- Smoke + perf checks after canary (script below)
```

kevin_h: LGTM. One ask — call out the manual rollback command in RN: `./tools/rollback.sh --to v2.14.0` and who to ping.

samir: Agree. Also add the quick checklist: smoke, 99th latency, error budget, and a couple of eval samples.

ops_lead: ops will monitor automated rollback. Manual rollback owner acknowledged. Change window OK for infra.

anya_pm: Proposed internal blurb: "Staging deploy scheduled 01:15 UTC — model pin + perf fixes; no expected user-facing changes. Watch latency dashboards and CI smoke. Will rollback on elevated errors." :eyes:

maria.g: Pasting the one-paragraph internal announce candidate below (draft):

> Heads up — staging deploy at 01:15 UTC will pin embeddings to `embed-1b-q4` and update serving runtime to v2.14.1. This is a small perf/stability rollout with a 10% canary for 30m. No expected user-facing changes, but please monitor latency and error dashboards. If the error rate exceeds thresholds, the system will auto-roll back to v2.14.0; manual rollback instructions are `./tools/rollback.sh --to v2.14.0` (manual owner: @kevin_h).

kevin_h: that's fine — I'll be on-call during the window and will run the smoke script after canary: `./scripts/smoke_test.sh --routes api/generate --qps 20`

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by maria.g: canary job `canary-20260321-01` -> 10% traffic, target group `dedicated-us-east-1`.

deploy-bot: Job started: canary-20260321-01; tracker: https://deploys.internal/runs/canary-20260321-01

samir: Add a short checklist to RN (one-liner each):
- smoke: `./scripts/smoke_test.sh --routes api/generate`
- perf: check `dashboards/latency/99th`
- errors: check `alerts/error-rate`
- quality: run `eval/run_sample_checks.py --suite quick`

ops_lead: I'll post the approved internal blurb at 00:45 UTC to #internal-announce and pin the RN gist. Also will tag @oncall and @pg-team.

maria.g: RN uploaded to gist: https://gist.github.com/rn/abc123 — pinned section: release bullets + checklist.

anya_pm: tiny wording tweak — replace "no expected user-facing changes" with "no expected user-facing changes, but please monitor." Then good to post. :shipit:

kevin_h: Tagged @oncall, I'll take manual rollback if needed. Leaving a note in the runbook for step-by-step.

ops_lead: Final confirmation: change window set, canary started, manual rollback owner assigned. Posting at 00:45 UTC as planned. :thumbsup:

maria.g: Thanks team. If canary looks good after 30m we proceed to full ramp. If anything spikes -> rollback to v2.14.0.

kevin_h: I'll run perf checks at +10m and +25m. Will post findings here.

samir: Added RN checklist to the doc. Good to go.
